import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def joinBST : BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty, r => r
  | BinarySearchTree.Node x l r, r2 => BinarySearchTree.Node x l (joinBST r r2)

def delAux : BinarySearchTree → Int → BinarySearchTree
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty, _ => BinarySearchTree.Empty
  | BinarySearchTree.Node x l r, v =>
      if v < x then BinarySearchTree.Node x (delAux l v) r
      else if x < v then BinarySearchTree.Node x l (delAux r v)
      else joinBST l r
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t v) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  delAux t v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : delete_precond t v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t \ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem view_empty : view BinarySearchTree.Empty = (∅ : Set Int) := by
  simp only [view]

theorem view_node (x : Int) (l r : BinarySearchTree) :
    view (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {x} := by
  simp only [view]

theorem is_bst_empty : is_bst BinarySearchTree.Empty := by
  simp only [is_bst]

theorem is_bst_node_iff (x : Int) (l r : BinarySearchTree) :
    is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) ↔
      ((∀ y ∈ view l, y < x) ∧ is_bst l ∧ (∀ y ∈ view r, y > x) ∧ is_bst r) := by
  simp only [is_bst]

theorem joinBST_empty (r : BinarySearchTree) :
    joinBST BinarySearchTree.Empty r = r := by
  simp only [joinBST]

theorem joinBST_node (x : Int) (l r r2 : BinarySearchTree) :
    joinBST (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) r2
      = BinarySearchTree.Node x l (joinBST r r2) := by
  simp only [joinBST]

theorem delAux_empty (v : Int) :
    delAux BinarySearchTree.Empty v = BinarySearchTree.Empty := by
  simp only [delAux]

theorem delAux_node (x : Int) (l r : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) :
    delAux (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v =
      (if v < x then BinarySearchTree.Node x (delAux l v) r
       else if x < v then BinarySearchTree.Node x l (delAux r v)
       else joinBST l r) := by
  simp only [delAux]

theorem joinBST_view : ∀ (l r : BinarySearchTree),
    view (joinBST l r) = view l ∪ view r := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | Empty =>
    intro r
    rw [joinBST_empty, view_empty]
    simp
  | Node x ll lr ihl ihr =>
    intro r
    rw [joinBST_node, view_node, ihr, view_node]
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto

theorem joinBST_bst : ∀ (l r : BinarySearchTree), is_bst l → is_bst r →
    (∀ a ∈ view l, ∀ b ∈ view r, a < b) → is_bst (joinBST l r) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | Empty =>
    intro r _ hr _
    rw [joinBST_empty]
    exact hr
  | Node x ll lr ihl ihr =>
    intro r hl hr hlt
    rw [is_bst_node_iff] at hl
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hl
    rw [joinBST_node, is_bst_node_iff]
    refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y hy
      rw [joinBST_view, Set.mem_union] at hy
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · exact h3 y hy
      · have hx : x ∈ view (BinarySearchTree.Node x ll lr) := by
          rw [view_node]; simp
        have := hlt x hx y hy
        omega
    · refine ihr r h4 hr ?_
      intro a ha b hb
      refine hlt a ?_ b hb
      rw [view_node]
      simp only [Set.mem_union]
      exact Or.inl (Or.inr ha)

theorem delAux_spec : ∀ (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int), is_bst t →
    is_bst (delAux t v) ∧ view (delAux t v) = view t \ {v} := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
    intro v _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [delAux_empty]
      exact is_bst_empty
    · rw [delAux_empty, view_empty]
      simp
  | Node x l r ihl ihr =>
    intro v ht
    rw [is_bst_node_iff] at ht
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ht
    obtain ⟨ihl1, ihl2⟩ := ihl v h2
    obtain ⟨ihr1, ihr2⟩ := ihr v h4
    rw [delAux_node]
    by_cases hv : v < x
    · rw [if_pos hv]
      have hvr : v ∉ view r := by
        intro hc
        have := h3 v hc
        omega
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [is_bst_node_iff]
        refine ⟨?_, ihl1, h3, h4⟩
        intro y hy
        rw [ihl2] at hy
        exact h1 y hy.1
      · ext y
        simp only [view_node, ihl2, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        constructor
        · rintro ((⟨hy, hne⟩ | hy) | hy)
          · exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl hy), hne⟩
          · refine ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr hy), ?_⟩
            intro hc
            exact hvr (by rw [← hc]; exact hy)
          · exact ⟨Or.inr hy, by omega⟩
        · rintro ⟨(hy | hy) | hy, hne⟩
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨hy, hne⟩)
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hy)
          · exact Or.inr hy
    · rw [if_neg hv]
      by_cases hv2 : x < v
      · rw [if_pos hv2]
        have hvl : v ∉ view l := by
          intro hc
          have := h1 v hc
          omega
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [is_bst_node_iff]
          refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_, ihr1⟩
          intro y hy
          rw [ihr2] at hy
          exact h3 y hy.1
        · ext y
          simp only [view_node, ihr2, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          constructor
          · rintro ((hy | ⟨hy, hne⟩) | hy)
            · refine ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl hy), ?_⟩
              intro hc
              exact hvl (by rw [← hc]; exact hy)
            · exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr hy), hne⟩
            · exact ⟨Or.inr hy, by omega⟩
          · rintro ⟨(hy | hy) | hy, hne⟩
            · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hy)
            · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨hy, hne⟩)
            · exact Or.inr hy
      · rw [if_neg hv2]
        have hvx : v = x := by omega
        refine ⟨joinBST_bst l r h2 h4 ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro a ha b hb
          have ha' := h1 a ha
          have hb' := h3 b hb
          omega
        · rw [joinBST_view]
          ext y
          simp only [view_node, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          constructor
          · rintro (hy | hy)
            · refine ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl hy), ?_⟩
              intro hc
              have := h1 y hy
              omega
            · refine ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr hy), ?_⟩
              intro hc
              have := h3 y hy
              omega
          · rintro ⟨(hy | hy) | hy, hne⟩
            · exact Or.inl hy
            · exact Or.inr hy
            · exact absurd (show y = v by omega) hne
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem delete_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t v) :
    delete_postcond t v (delete t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have h := delAux_spec t v h_precond
  exact h
  -- !benchmark @end proof

## Analysis

**Implementation.** The naive BST delete: at a node with key `x`,
- if `v < x`, recurse left,
- if `x < v`, recurse right,
- otherwise (`v = x`) we must remove this node and *merge* its two subtrees.

For the merge I use a helper `joinBST l r` (valid when every key in `l` is smaller than every key in `r`):
```
joinBST Empty r = r
joinBST (Node x ll lr) r = Node x ll (joinBST lr r)
```
It just walks down the right spine of `l` and hangs `r` there. Its view is `view l ∪ view r`, and it preserves the BST invariant whenever `l`'s keys are all below `r`'s keys.

**Correctness.** Two lemmas about `joinBST`:
* `joinBST_view : view (joinBST l r) = view l ∪ view r` (induction on `l`),
* `joinBST_bst`: BST-ness preserved given the separation hypothesis (induction on `l`).

Then a combined induction for `delAux`: assuming `is_bst t`, both `is_bst (delAux t v)` and `view (delAux t v) = view t \ {v}` hold. The view part uses the BST invariant: e.g. when `v < x`, every key in the right subtree is `> x > v`, so `v` cannot occur there, hence removing `v` only from the left subtree suffices; all arithmetic side goals are closed by `omega`.

Finally `delete t v h := delAux t v`, and the postcondition is exactly the lemma.

To make rewriting robust I first prove explicit unfolding lemmas (`view_node`, `is_bst_node_iff`, `delAux_node`, ...).
